title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 2nd Proof The Quran As Decree And Its Miraculousness

questions.question: What is the “decree” that the passage says the Prophet holds?
questions.answer: It is the Qur’an.

questions.question: Who gave this decree?
questions.answer: The Lord of the universe, meaning Allah.

questions.question: About how many people in each century are said to accept and confirm this decree?
questions.answer: More than three hundred million people.

questions.question: How many ways does the passage say this decree is amazing in?
questions.answer: Seven ways.

questions.question: How many aspects of miraculousness are mentioned for the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Forty.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the source of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an is the speech of the Creator of all things.

questions.question: Where does the passage say detailed proofs about the Qur’an’s miraculous nature can be found?
questions.answer: In the Twenty-Fifth Word, called The Miraculousness of the Qur’an.

questions.question: Why does the passage move on instead of explaining all those proofs there?
questions.answer: Because those matters were already explained in that other work.

questions.question: What job of the Prophet is highlighted in this passage?
questions.answer: He is described as the one who brings and announces the decree.

questions.question: Why does the traveller say lying is impossible for the one who delivers this decree?
questions.answer: Because lying would go against the decree and be betrayal toward the One who sent it.

questions.question: What main idea about the Prophet is this passage trying to prove?
questions.answer: It is trying to show that he is truthful.

questions.question: What important thing is placed in his hand in the passage?
questions.answer: A message from Allah, which is the Qur’an.

questions.question: How does the passage show that this message is widely trusted?
questions.answer: It says huge numbers of people in every century have accepted it.

questions.question: What does calling the Qur’an wondrous in several ways teach us about it?
questions.answer: It teaches that the Qur’an is extraordinary and not like ordinary speech.

questions.question: If the Qur’an has many signs of miraculousness, what does that suggest about where it came from?
questions.answer: It suggests it came from Allah, not from people.

questions.question: What kind of book is named as giving strong proof for this subject?
questions.answer: A treatise called The Miraculousness of the Qur’an.

questions.question: According to the passage, what would be wrong with a messenger lying about Allah’s decree?
questions.answer: It would be both disobedience to the message and betrayal of Allah.

questions.question: Why does being the carrier of Allah’s message make truthfulness especially necessary?
questions.answer: Because someone trusted to deliver Allah’s words must be completely honest.

questions.question: In one sentence, what conclusion does the traveller reach?
questions.answer: He concludes that the bearer of the Qur’an cannot be a liar.

questions.question: What holy book is the center of this passage?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What repeated support from people is mentioned about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: People in every century have accepted and confirmed it.

questions.question: Does the passage present the Qur’an as ordinary or miraculous? Explain briefly.
questions.answer: It presents the Qur’an as miraculous because it says it has many amazing features.

questions.question: What number is given for the Qur’an’s miraculous features?
questions.answer: Forty aspects are mentioned.

questions.question: What does the passage say those proofs show about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They show that it is the word of the Creator.

questions.question: Which specific work is said to explain these proofs in detail?
questions.answer: The Twenty-Fifth Word.

questions.question: What two roles of the Prophet are named near the end of the passage?
questions.answer: He is the one who carries the decree and publicly announces it.

questions.question: What moral judgment is made about lying by such a person?
questions.answer: It is said to be impossible, because it would mean faithlessness toward Allah and His message.

questions.question: According to the passage, whose decree is the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It is the decree of the Lord of the universe.

questions.question: What does the large number of people accepting it in every century help show?
questions.answer: It helps show its lasting influence and strong confirmation among people.

questions.question: Why is the Qur’an important in the argument about the Prophet’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: Because carrying such a divine message means he must be trustworthy.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an being amazing in more than one way?
questions.answer: It says its wonder appears in seven different ways.

questions.question: What else, besides the seven ways, is said about its miraculous nature?
questions.answer: It also has forty aspects of miraculousness.

questions.question: What claim is made about the Qur’an’s origin?
questions.answer: It is said to come from the Creator of all beings.

questions.question: Why does the text not stop to give all the proofs here?
questions.answer: Because another book already explains them in detail with strong evidence.

questions.question: What does “conveyor and proclaimer” mean in simple words here?
questions.answer: It means the one who brings the message and tells it to people.

questions.question: What would lying do to the trust between the messenger and the Sender?
questions.answer: It would break that trust and count as betrayal.

questions.question: What final lesson should a student take from this passage about the Prophet?
questions.answer: That his connection to the Qur’an is a strong proof of his honesty.

questions.question: In this passage, what is being used as proof for the Prophet’s honesty?
questions.answer: The Qur’an is being used as proof.

questions.question: How is the Qur’an introduced at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: As a decree placed in his hand by Allah.

questions.question: What detail shows that the Qur’an’s message continued through time?
questions.answer: It was accepted in every century by very many people.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of people who accepted it?
questions.answer: It says more than three hundred million accepted and affirmed it in each century.

questions.question: What do the seven ways of wonder and forty miraculous aspects help us understand?
questions.answer: They help us understand that the Qur’an is far above normal human speech.

questions.question: What conclusion is connected to the Qur’an being the word of the Creator?
questions.answer: That the one delivering it would not lie about it.

questions.question: What source is named for fuller study of this topic?
questions.answer: The Twenty-Fifth Word, The Miraculousness of the Qur’an.

questions.question: Why would falsehood be especially serious in this case?
questions.answer: Because it would be against Allah’s decree and against the trust of delivering it.

questions.question: Write the traveller’s conclusion in simple words.
questions.answer: A person who faithfully brings Allah’s book would not be a liar.

questions.question: What single object or message is most important in this passage?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: Who is said to have sent this message?
questions.answer: Allah, the Lord of the universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say people did with this message in every century?
questions.answer: They accepted it and confirmed it.

questions.question: How many kinds of wonder are mentioned first?
questions.answer: Seven.

questions.question: How many miraculous aspects are mentioned after that?
questions.answer: Forty.

questions.question: What big truth do those proofs support about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They support that it is Allah’s word.

questions.question: What title is given for the book that explains these proofs in detail?
questions.answer: The Miraculousness of the Qur’an.

questions.question: What can we infer about the Prophet from his role as the announcer of Allah’s decree?
questions.answer: We can infer that he is faithful and truthful.

questions.question: According to the traveller, why is lying impossible for him?
questions.answer: Because lying would mean breaking the message and betraying the One who sent it.
